content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local currency collapsed and international payment platforms like Stripe were blocked, a new commerce infrastructure emerged. This was not a workaround, but base-layer infrastructure: GitHub Pages, [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-3|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-2|cloudflare]] Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and Cloudflare R2, all free or low-cost. Now, digital creators worldwide can collect payments without relying on Stripe or PayPal, using NOWPayments and the Sovereign Stack.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This is not just a payment processor, but a digital commerce stack that gives creators control over their infrastructure, their data, and their revenue. Without relying on third-party platforms, creators can deploy their own stacks, load their own products, and configure their own payment gateways. This means no more 10% fees from Gumroad, no more platform restrictions, and no more dependence on Stripe or PayPal for online sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Stack combines GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments integrates with the stack, processing payments and sending instant confirmation to creators. This architecture allows for seamless, automatic delivery of digital products, from [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-3|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]] to courses, templates, and software.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who want to sell their products online without relying on Stripe or PayPal. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or any other country with restricted payment platforms, the Sovereign Stack gives you the freedom to collect payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, using NOWPayments' 0.5% fee. No more platform fees, no more restrictions, and no more dependence on third-party platforms.
The Sovereign Stack saves creators $921 per month in fees compared to Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the Sovereign Stack today, follow these concrete steps: 1. Choose your hosting platform, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Set up your file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic payment processing. 6. Load your digital products and configure your payment gateways. 7. Test your stack thoroughly and deploy to production.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides instant download and deployment of the Sovereign Stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For digital creators looking for more control over their infrastructure, sales channels, and revenue streams, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides instant download and deployment of the Sovereign Stack. Also, explore our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about the Sovereign Stack and NOWPayments.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does Gumroad charge on every sale?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in $921 more per month in retained revenue at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
Can I use the Sovereign Stack with multiple payment gateways?
Yes, you can integrate multiple payment gateways with the Sovereign Stack using NOWPayments, allowing you to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours, includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours, includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering more advanced features and configuration options.
Can I use the Sovereign Stack with my existing e-commerce platform?

Yes, you can integrate the Sovereign Stack with your existing e-commerce platform using NOWPayments, allowing you to leverage the benefits of a sovereign digital commerce stack while maintaining your existing sales channels.
What happens if I experience issues with my Sovereign Stack?
Our 30-day support guarantee ensures that you receive assistance with any issues you encounter with your Sovereign Stack, from deployment to configuration and troubleshooting.
